skills.summary: Browser automation via agent-browser CLI — navigate websites, fill forms, click buttons, take screenshots, extract data, or test web apps.
Interact with GitHub using the gh CLI — issues, PRs, CI runs, and advanced queries via gh issue, gh pr, gh run, and gh api.
Read and control I2C and SPI peripherals on Sipeed boards (LicheeRV Nano, MaixCAM, NanoKVM).
Configure, extend, debug, or contribute to Rhizome itself — CLI commands, config.json, gateway, auth, models, skills, MCP servers, cron, routing, and sessions.
Create, update, or review Rhizome skills — writing new SKILL.md files, turning repeated workflows into reusable skills, organizing scripts and references.
Stealth browser automation via a Patchright-based MCP server — for sites that block or detect normal automation (bot detection, CAPTCHAs, fingerprinting).
Summarize or extract text/transcripts from URLs, podcasts, and local files — a great fallback for transcribing YouTube and video content.
Remote-control tmux sessions for interactive CLIs by sending keystrokes and scraping pane output.
Get current weather and forecasts with verified location matching — no API key required.
